name: Mirror Linear tasks to Todoist
description: When a Linear issue is assigned to me, create a matching task in my Todoist.

triggers.description: Runs when a Linear issue is created and assigned to me

steps.title: Create Todoist task
steps.description: Creates a matching task in my Todoist inbox with a link back to the Linear issue.
steps.prompt:
Using the todoist "add-tasks" tool, create one new task in the user's Inbox (projectId "inbox") that mirrors the Linear issue just created.

Use these values from the Linear issue trigger (`` trigger.issue `` object):
- Task title: `` trigger.issue.title ``
- Task description: write a Markdown description that includes the Linear issue URL from `` trigger.issue.url `` and a clearly labeled link to the issue (identifier `` trigger.issue.identifier ``).

Call mcp.todoist['add-tasks'] with a single task. Include the description on the task so the Linear issue identifier is preserved for later syncing. Do not set a due date or priority unless the trigger provides them; use only the values described above.

steps.title: Summarize result
steps.description: Build a short summary of the mirrored task.
